Stop people from creating accounts with temporary or throwaway email addresses, such as `@temp-mail.com`. These addresses are commonly used for spam, abuse, and one-time sign-ups you can never reach again.

<Aside>

This setting is off by default. It applies to every organization in the environment.

</Aside>

1. In Kinde, go to **Settings > Environment > Policies**.
2. In the **Sign up** section, switch on **Block disposable email addresses**.
3. Select **Save**.

    ![Kinde block disposable email addresses toggle](https://imagedelivery.net/skPPZTHzSlcslvHjesZQcQ/7138a05b-1a2c-4d9e-44ea-27621cbc3d00/socialsharingimage)

## About the blocking feature

Kinde checks the email domain at self-service sign-up against a list of known disposable providers that Kinde maintains. If the domain is on the list, sign-up is blocked and the user sees an error asking them to try a different sign-up method.

Subdomains of a listed domain are included. For example, `anything.temp-mail.com` is blocked when `temp-mail.com` is on the list.

<Aside type="warning">

You cannot view or edit the domain list. Use this setting to cover known throwaway providers.

</Aside>

### What is blocked

- Self-service sign-up with email, including when someone starts on the sign-in screen and chooses to create an account
- Social sign-up, if the social connection is set to create a user
- Subdomains of a listed domain (for example `anything.temp-mail.com` if `temp-mail.com` is listed)

### What is not blocked

- Existing users signing in, even if their domain is later added to the list
- People you invite
- Users you add yourself: in the dashboard, via the Management API, bulk import, or SCIM
- Sign-up with a phone number or username only (there is no email to check)


See [Set global access policies](/build/set-up-options/access-policies/) for additional sign-up options you can configure.

## Block additional domains with a custom workflow

The built-in list covers known throwaway providers. You cannot view or edit that list.

To block extra domains that are not on Kinde’s list, use a user pre-registration workflow; see [Block disposable emails with Kinde workflows](/workflows/workflow-tutorials/block-disposable-emails/) with your own list. 


<Aside type="warning">

A workflow cannot override this setting. If a domain is on Kinde’s disposable list and the switch is on, sign-up is blocked before the workflow runs.

</Aside>
